decision.rule: Score = greedy integration + greedy development - 2 x parent successes lost. Carry forward the higher of large and committee (tie to committee) only if it scores at least as high as small.
decision.outcome: Neither method is carried forward: the large module (69) outscored the committee (65) but not the small module (71).

findings.data_split: Members trained on about a third of the verified experience (234-270 sequences) reached 47-56 of 64 integration cases; the small module on all 740 reached 61.
findings.preservation: The committee was the only system that lost no parent success on either split.
findings.conservatism: In 8 of the 53 integration cases where at least two members succeeded alone, the committee failed: the parent tie-break kept its action when members split.

prior_launches.outcome: Methodology study stopped at startup: the worker passed runtime parameters instead of the pinned inventory (KeyError: collection) before reading any data ($0.22).
